title: The Dashboard
subtitle: What each card shows and how its figures load

segments.text: This tutorial shows what the Crewflow Dashboard tells you, and how its figures behave. Everything you see uses fictional demonstration data.
As the data arrives, each number counts up to its value, and the bars and fills grow into place. The whole reveal takes just over a second.
The strip at the top splits your current offers into pending, accepted by staff, and confirmed by a manager. Open shifts is the share of shifts in the next thirty days that are still open.
Beside it are your totals: Staff, the Venue managers in your workspace, and your Venues.
Hours worked adds up completed attendance for each of the last seven days. The large figure is the daily average, across the days that have recorded hours.
Shifts by venue counts the last thirty days of shifts at your busiest venues.
Shift readiness follows your next shift in the coming fourteen days, from staffing and attendance through to the finalised timesheet.
Further down, the offer pipeline breaks your current offers down by stage, and the week view lists this week's shifts with their staffing.
Now open Users, and select the Venue managers tab. This is the same list of Venue managers that the Dashboard counts.
Return to the Dashboard. Because you came back on purpose, the figures replay their short reveal.
Crewflow also refreshes these figures in the background when something changes, for example when a staff member accepts an offer. When the values are unchanged, nothing moves, so the page stays calm.
If a figure cannot be loaded, or is not available to you, it shows a dash rather than a zero. And if your device is set to reduce motion, the final values appear straight away.
To go deeper, select the arrow on any card to open the page behind it.
